He read it three times, then climbed the spiral stairs, lit the lamp early, and stared out at the water, wondering whether the sender had ever come home.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台缓缓降温的机器，路灯还亮着，街道却空得只剩风。环卫工人推着长长的扫把，沙沙地划过积水的路面；早点铺的蒸笼刚揭开，白雾裹着包子的香气缓缓升起。高架桥上偶尔驶过一辆货车，灯光掠过玻璃幕墙，留下一道短暂的亮痕。远处的写字楼还有几扇窗未熄，像是有人仍在与夜晚对峙。天边尚未泛白，城市在沉睡与苏醒之间停顿了一下，等待新一天的第一声喧嚣。", "w03": "- Recursion means a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- It is like a set of nesting dolls: you open one, and inside is a smaller doll of the same kind, until you reach the tiniest one that cannot be opened.\n- Every recursive function needs a stopping point, called the base case, so it does not keep calling itself forever."}
